# TnT Ventures

> TnT Ventures is Robert Kunze's independent angel investment vehicle, operated by TnT Beteiligungs GmbH in Munich, Germany. It backs early-stage founders in supply-chain technology and selected adjacent opportunities.

## Focus

- Supply-chain technology: software, data and automation that improve the flow of goods, information and decisions.
- Selected adjacencies: industrial, deep-tech and infrastructure opportunities where relevant operating experience creates an advantage.
- Early partnership: primarily pre-seed and seed investments with a long-term, operator-led perspective.

## Selected portfolio

- Barkawi Technologies: https://www.barkawi.com/
- Starflight Dynamics: https://www.starflight-dynamics.com/
